title: Father's death and birth dates
summary: Hilda gives her father's age at death (52) and dates: died 23 November 1933, born 26 October.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I can remember years ago my daddy used to play in what was it?
Yeah, he played in Sturryville. Well I was wondering, first of all, do you remember about how old he was when he died and the date that he died?
My father was 52 years old and he died November 23rd, 1933. 33.
You don't remember his exact birthday I guess?
Oh, it's when he was born.
We can figure it up. We can subtract that all right. It's all we have. I'm sorry, I took your chair.
October 26th was his birth date. That's the birth date.
